steps.sql:
CREATE TABLE t1(c, b, a, PRIMARY KEY(b, a)) WITHOUT ROWID;
  INSERT INTO t1 VALUES(1, 2, 3), (4, 5, 6);
ALTER TABLE t1 DROP c;
SELECT * FROM t1;
SELECT sql FROM sqlite_schema;
steps.expect: {CREATE TABLE t1(b, a, PRIMARY KEY(b, a)) WITHOUT ROWID}

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE x1(a PRIMARY KEY, b, c);
ALTER TABLE x1 DROP COLUMN a
CREATE TABLE x1(a,b,c,d,e, PRIMARY KEY(b,c,d));
ALTER TABLE x1 DROP COLUMN c
CREATE TABLE x1(a PRIMARY KEY, b, c UNIQUE);
ALTER TABLE x1 DROP COLUMN c
CREATE TABLE x1(a PRIMARY KEY, b, c, UNIQUE(b, c));
ALTER TABLE x1 DROP COLUMN c
steps.expect: 1 {error in table x1 after drop column: no such column: c}

steps.sql:
CREATE TABLE 'one two'('x y', 'z 1', 'a b');
  CREATE INDEX idx ON 'one two'('z 1');
ALTER TABLE 'one two' DROP COLUMN 'z 1'
steps.expect: 1 {error in index idx after drop column: no such column: z 1}

steps.sql:
CREATE TABLE x1(a, b, c);
  CREATE INDEX idx ON x1(a);
ALTER TABLE x1 DROP COLUMN a;
steps.expect: 1 {error in index idx after drop column: no such column: a}

steps.sql:
CREATE TABLE x1234(a, b, c PRIMARY KEY) WITHOUT ROWID;
  CREATE INDEX i1 ON x1234(b) WHERE ((a+5) % 10)==0;
ALTER TABLE x1234 DROP a
steps.expect: 1 {error in index i1 after drop column: no such column: a}

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE x1234(a, b, c PRIMARY KEY, CHECK(((a+5)%10)!=0)) WITHOUT ROWID;
ALTER TABLE x1234 DROP a
steps.expect: 1 {error in table x1234 after drop column: no such column: a}

steps.sql:
CREATE TABLE p1(x, y UNIQUE);
  CREATE TABLE c1(u, v, FOREIGN KEY (v) REFERENCES p1(y))
ALTER TABLE c1 DROP v
steps.expect: 1 {error in table c1 after drop column: unknown column "v" in foreign key definition}

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE c1(u, v, w AS (u+v));
ALTER TABLE c1 DROP v
steps.expect: 1 {error in table c1 after drop column: no such column: v}

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE c1(u, v, w AS (u+v) STORED);
ALTER TABLE c1 DROP u
steps.expect: 1 {error in table c1 after drop column: no such column: u}

steps.sql: ALTER TABLE c1 DROP w
steps.expect: 1 {error in trigger tr1 after drop column: no such column: new.w}

steps.sql:
CREATE TABLE c1(u, v, w);
  CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT u, v, w FROM c1;
ALTER TABLE c1 DROP w
steps.expect: 1 {error in view v1 after drop column: no such column: w}

steps.sql:
CREATE TABLE c1(u, v, w);
  CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT * FROM c1 WHERE w IS NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE c1 DROP w
steps.expect: 1 {error in view v1 after drop column: no such column: w}
